items.title: Show HN: AutoRules AI – Check all files against a list of questions
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been building DarkAuth , a zero-knowledge OAuth/OIDC server that uses OPAQUE (RFC 9380) to ensure users’ passwords and derived encryption keys never reach the server. It’s proper zero-knowledge - the server literally can’t see the password, not even encrypted.

title_i18n.en: Show HN: AutoRules AI – Check all files against a list of questions
title_i18n.zh: 展示HN：AutoRules AI——依据问题清单自动检查所有文件
title_i18n.es: Mostrar HN: AutoRules IA – Verifica todos los archivos con una lista de preguntas

excerpt_i18n.en: I’ve been building DarkAuth , a zero-knowledge OAuth/OIDC server that uses OPAQUE (RFC 9380) to ensure users’ passwords and derived encryption keys never reach the server. It’s proper zero-knowledge - the server literally can’t see the password, not even encrypted.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我一直在开发DarkAuth，这是一个零知识OAuth/OIDC服务器，采用OPAQUE协议（RFC 9380）确保用户密码及衍生的加密密钥绝不传至服务器。这是真正的零知识机制——服务器完全无法获取这些信息。
